name: mnemonic_exile_shard_projector
label: Exile Shard Projector
poeticVision: Feel the gut-wrenching decision to weaponize a precious, fading fragment of your own past. Watch in a blend of horror and grim satisfaction as an enemy convulses, momentarily ensnared by the distorted echo of your memory, slowing their pursuit, but knowing that piece of 'you' is now corrupted and lost forever.

parameters.name: projectile_scene_path
parameters.description: Path to the PackedScene for the MemoryShardProjectile.

parameters.name: projectile_speed
parameters.description: The initial speed at which the memory shard projectile is launched.

parameters.name: projectile_damage
parameters.description: The amount of physical damage the projectile deals on impact.

parameters.name: debuff_duration
parameters.description: The duration (in seconds) for which the memory distortion debuff is applied to the enemy.

parameters.name: muzzle_node_path
parameters.description: The NodePath to a child Node3D that represents the projectile's launch point (muzzle). If not found, the projector's own transform is used.

verdict: A desperate weapon born of self-sacrifice, it carves survival from the very essence of who you are, leaving an indelible scar on memory's fragile canvas.
impact: The player will constantly weigh immediate survival against the permanent erosion of their identity, transforming every combat encounter into a profound, personal struggle against self-loss. This mechanic forces a deep, emotional connection to resource management, making every 'shot' a gut-wrenching decision.
